chapters.title: The Beginning of the End
content: Kim Dokja is an ordinary office worker who has been reading a web novel called 'Three Ways to Survive in a Ruined World' for ten years.
The novel has over 3,000 chapters and is the longest he has ever read.
Kim Dokja is the sole reader of this unpopular web novel.
The novel's protagonist is Yoo Joonghyuk, a regressor who has lived countless lives.
On the day the novel is completed, the world suddenly changes.
The sky splits open and monsters begin appearing everywhere.
The novel's scenarios become reality in Kim Dokja's world.
Kim Dokja realizes that he is the only one who knows the future.
He has read the entire story and knows every plot point.
The first scenario begins: 'Survive or die.'
People around him are killed by monsters and other humans.
Kim Dokja uses his knowledge to survive the initial chaos.
He knows that the apocalypse has only just begun.
Kim Dokja is determined to survive and reach the end of the scenarios.

chapters.title: The First Scenario
content: The first scenario requires all survivors to kill a living creature.
Most people choose to kill insects or small animals.
Kim Dokja knows that the real test is much darker.
The scenario is designed to force humans to kill each other.
He watches as people in his subway station begin to panic.
Some people kill others to fulfill the scenario requirements.
Kim Dokja refuses to kill a human being.
He remembers a trick from the novel to bypass the condition.
Kim Dokja sacrifices his own health to survive the scenario.
He is injured but alive when the first scenario ends.
The survivors are given rewards for completing the task.
Kim Dokja receives a skill called 'Bookmark'.
The skill allows him to use the powers of characters from the novel.
His unique knowledge gives him an enormous advantage.

chapters.title: The Protagonist
content: Kim Dokja encounters Yoo Joonghyuk for the first time.
Yoo Joonghyuk is the protagonist of the novel and a regressor.
He has lived through countless timelines and experienced endless suffering.
Yoo Joonghyuk is cold, ruthless, and only focused on survival.
He has no trust in anyone after being betrayed many times.
Kim Dokja knows everything about Yoo Joonghyuk's past lives.
He understands the protagonist better than anyone else.
Kim Dokja decides to join Yoo Joonghyuk's group.
Yoo Joonghyuk is suspicious of Kim Dokja from the beginning.
Kim Dokja uses his knowledge to prove his usefulness.
He helps Yoo Joonghyuk avoid dangerous situations.
The protagonist is confused by Kim Dokja's strange insights.
Kim Dokja keeps his knowledge a secret from everyone.
He knows that revealing the truth could be dangerous.

chapters.title: The Constellations
content: Kim Dokja learns about the Constellations that watch the scenarios.
The Constellations are powerful beings from beyond the world.
They enjoy watching humans struggle and suffer in the scenarios.
The Constellations can sponsor humans and give them power.
Kim Dokja is noticed by several Constellations because of his actions.
One Constellation, 'The Secretive Plotter', takes special interest in him.
The Constellations communicate through the Dokkaebi, the scenario moderators.
Kim Dokja knows that Constellations can be both helpful and dangerous.
He understands that the Constellations are using humans for entertainment.
Kim Dokja receives sponsorship from several Constellations.
The power of the Constellations makes him stronger.
He also gains the ability to use 'Story' as a weapon.
Kim Dokja's connection to the Constellations becomes deeper.
He must be careful not to become their puppet.

chapters.title: The Third Scenario
content: The third scenario takes place in an abandoned theme park.
All survivors must complete a series of dangerous challenges.
Kim Dokja knows that this scenario is designed to kill many people.
He uses his knowledge to guide the group through the park.
Yoo Joonghyuk is impressed by Kim Dokja's unexpected abilities.
The group faces monsters that were created from the park's attractions.
Kim Dokja leads the survivors through each challenge carefully.
He sacrifices himself to save others multiple times.
Yoo Joonghyuk begins to see Kim Dokja in a different light.
The scenario ends with the group barely surviving.
Kim Dokja is injured but alive at the end.
He learns more about how the scenarios are designed.
The Dokkaebi are making the challenges harder deliberately.
Kim Dokja realizes that the difficulty will only increase.

chapters.title: The Disaster of Floods
content: A new disaster called the 'Disaster of Floods' appears.
The disaster takes the form of a giant monster made of water.
It destroys everything in its path and kills thousands.
Kim Dokja knows the identity of the disaster from the novel.
The disaster is actually a transformed human named Shin Yoosung.
Shin Yoosung was a victim who became a monster.
Kim Dokja decides to save Shin Yoosung instead of killing her.
Yoo Joonghyuk disagrees and wants to destroy the disaster.
Kim Dokja argues that there is always another way.
He uses his knowledge to find the disaster's weakness.
Kim Dokja reaches the core of the disaster and meets Shin Yoosung.
He offers her a chance to return to being human.
Shin Yoosung is moved by Kim Dokja's kindness.
The disaster is stopped without bloodshed.

chapters.title: The Fourth Wall
content: Kim Dokja discovers his unique skill called 'Fourth Wall'.
The skill allows him to view the world as a story.
He can see the 'text' of the world around him.
The Fourth Wall protects him from mental attacks and manipulation.
Kim Dokja realizes that his knowledge is more than just memory.
The skill connects him to the novel in a deeper way.
He begins to see the Constellations as readers of a story.
Kim Dokja understands that he is also a character now.
The boundaries between fiction and reality become blurred.
Kim Dokja questions his own existence and identity.
He wonders if he is truly a reader or a character.
The Fourth Wall becomes his greatest asset and burden.
Kim Dokja must learn to use the skill effectively.
The skill will be crucial for surviving future scenarios.

chapters.title: The Demon King
content: Kim Dokja and his group face a powerful Demon King.
The Demon King is one of the strongest beings in the scenarios.
Yoo Joonghyuk has died to the Demon King in previous regressions.
Kim Dokja knows the Demon King's weakness from the novel.
The battle against the Demon King is brutal and desperate.
Many of Kim Dokja's companions are killed in the fight.
He uses every skill and knowledge at his disposal.
Kim Dokja sacrifices himself to defeat the Demon King.
He dies in the battle but is revived by his skills.
The Demon King is finally defeated and sealed away.
Kim Dokja's sacrifice changes the story's outcome.
Yoo Joonghyuk is shocked by Kim Dokja's actions.
The protagonist begins to see Kim Dokja as more than a stranger.
Their relationship deepens after the battle.

chapters.title: The Truth of the World
content: Kim Dokja discovers the ultimate truth about the world.
The world is actually a story created by the 'Most Ancient Dream'.
The Most Ancient Dream is the original reader of the novel.
Kim Dokja realizes that he is connected to this being.
The scenarios are part of a larger narrative being told.
The Constellations are also characters in this story.
Kim Dokja understands that he must reach the 'Final Scenario'.
The final scenario will determine the fate of everything.
Kim Dokja's memories of the novel begin to fade.
He is losing his knowledge of the future.
Kim Dokja must rely on his companions more than ever.
He shares the truth with Yoo Joonghyuk and the others.
They must work together to reach the end.
The weight of the truth is almost unbearable.

chapters.title: The Final Scenario
content: Kim Dokja reaches the final scenario of the world.
The scenario is called 'The End of the World'.
He must face the 'Outer Gods' who exist beyond the story.
Kim Dokja's companions are all with him for the final battle.
Yoo Joonghyuk fights alongside Kim Dokja as equals.
The battle against the Outer Gods is beyond imagination.
Kim Dokja sacrifices himself to save the world.
He becomes the new 'Most Ancient Dream'.
Kim Dokja exists outside of the world as a reader.
His companions cannot see him or reach him.
Kim Dokja watches over the world he saved.
He is both inside and outside of the story.
The world continues because of his sacrifice.
Kim Dokja's journey as a reader and character ends.

chapters.title: The Epilogue
content: Kim Dokja's companions continue living in the saved world.
They remember Kim Dokja and his sacrifices.
Yoo Joonghyuk is determined to find a way to reach him.
He searches for a method to connect to the 'Most Ancient Dream'.
Kim Dokja watches from beyond the story.
He feels happiness seeing his friends happy.
Kim Dokja realizes that he has finally found his story.
He is no longer just a reader of someone else's story.
Kim Dokja's story is one of courage and sacrifice.
The Constellations and Dokkaebi are changed by his example.
A new world is built on the foundations of his sacrifice.
Kim Dokja is remembered as a legend.
He is the reader who became the protagonist.
The story ends with hope and the promise of reunion.
